reviewItem.question: Does "Shallow evaluation of Variables: Kyverno performs nested variable substitution by default, this may not be desirable in certain situations" mean a change to protocol-behavior:kyverno|name=shallow-variable-substitution (added)?

proposed.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds a `{{- ... }}` notation for shallow (one-time) variable substitution, so nested `{{ }}` content such as HCL is not resolved.
